about_subtitle: We are a team of enthusiasts who love Ukraine and want to show its beauty to everyone
about_story_text1: 'Discover Ukraine' was born from a love of travel and a desire to show the world the incredible beauty of our country. It all started with a small group of friends who decided to explore the most remote corners of the Carpathians. With each time, our journeys became longer and our routes more interesting.
about_story_text2: Today, we are a professional team that has created over 50 unique routes across Ukraine. We personally test every track to ensure your safety and unforgettable experiences. Our mission is to make travel accessible, interesting, and safe for everyone.
about_values_subtitle: What inspires and drives us forward
about_safety_text: Every route is checked by our experienced guides. We guarantee safe conditions for travel.
about_love_text: We truly love our country and strive to show its best sides to every traveler.
about_eco_text: We care about nature and promote responsible tourism. We leave no traces except pleasant memories.
about_community_text: We create not just tours, but a real family of like-minded people where everyone can find new friends.
about_contact_subtitle: We are always happy to answer your questions
